newsitem.title: USA: Apple ships system software enhancements.
newsitem.headline: Apple ships system software enhancements.

text.p: Apple Computer Inc said it released system software enhancements for its Mac OS 7.6 operating system, which was released in January.
The Mac OS 7.6.1 update's objective is to improve stability and reliability, and bring Mac OS 7.6 support to recently introduced computers not supported by Mac OS 7.6.

Mac OS 7.6.1 update is available as a floppy disk set, and installs on computers running Mac OS 7.6 and computers supported by Mac OS 7.6, including PowerPC computers made by Mac OS licensees, Power Macintosh computers, 68040-based computers, and 68030-based computers that support 32-bit memory addressing. The update is available electronically.
